metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the Rust CLI tool in `output/` (Cargo 2021, no dependencies).

- Project: `output/Cargo.toml`, entrypoint `output/src/main.rs`
- Supports actions: `inspect`, `render`, `inspect_gedzip`, `render_gedzip`
- GEDCOM parsing builds the canonical tree and normalizes `CONT` into embedded `\\n` in `payload`
- GEDCOM rendering re-emits `CONT` lines from embedded newlines in `payload`
- Validates key spec rules (line hierarchy, `0 HEAD` first with `GEDC`, `0 TRLR` last with no substructures; `CONT` ordering/shape)
- GEDZIP: base64 ZIP with required `gedcom.ged` plus attachments (stored/uncompressed ZIP entries only); attachments returned/accepted as base64

Build/run:
- `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml`
- `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- --input <path> --output <path>`
